items.name: 1. Knee-to-wall dorsiflexion
items.detail: Toes ~4-5 in from wall, drive knee over toes keeping heel down. 10 reps/side, ease back to find your max distance. Track the distance over time.

items.name: 2. Calf raise / heel drop on step
items.detail: Balls of feet on a step, heels off edge. Rise up to strengthen, slowly drop heels below the step to stretch. 2-3 sets of 30 sec (or 10-15 reps).

items.name: 3. Soleus bent-knee heel drop
items.detail: Same step position but with a soft knee bend to bias the soleus. 2-3 sets of 30 sec.

items.name: 4. Banded ankle distraction (joint mob)
items.detail: Anchor band low, loop around front of ankle, step out for tension. Drive knee forward over toes through the new range. 1-2 min/ankle.

items.name: 5. Loaded heel drop (progression)
items.detail: Hold a light DB/KB while lowering heels off the step for deeper, loaded dorsiflexion. 2-3 sets of 30 sec — only when warm.

items.name: 1. 90/90 hip switches
items.detail: Seated, front + back leg both at 90°. Hold, then rotate floor-to-floor to train internal + external rotation. 1 min/side, several slow switches.

items.name: 2. Couch stretch
items.detail: Kneel with rear shin up a wall, front foot planted, squeeze glute and tall torso to open the hip flexor. 1-2 min/side. Add a band pull from the hip socket if available.

items.name: 3. Pigeon
items.detail: Front shin across, back leg long; keep chest tall and only load what's comfortable. 1-2 min/side for the glute / external rotators.

items.name: 4. Figure-4 / seated piriformis
items.detail: Ankle over opposite knee, gently press knee down (or pull shin in seated). 1 min/side.

items.name: 5. Banded hip distraction (opener)
items.detail: Band high around the hip crease, walk out for tension, sink into a deep lunge or squat to clear impingement. 1-2 min/side.

items.name: 1. Wall slides / wall angels
items.detail: Back, ribs and low back to the wall; arms at 90°, slide up like a snow angel keeping contact, then return. 2 sets of 10-12. Don't let the ribs flare.

items.name: 2. Band pull-apart (T)
items.detail: Band at shoulder height, arms straight, pull apart to a 'T'. Shoulders down, ribs tucked. 10-15 reps.

items.name: 3. High plank shoulder taps
items.detail: Plank, hands under shoulders; tap opposite shoulder without hips shifting. 20-30 sec, controlled.

items.name: 4. Banded overhead press-out
items.detail: Anchor band ~elbow height, press through full shoulder flexion for stability through range. 10-12 reps/side.

items.name: 5. Sleeper stretch (internal rotation)
items.detail: Side-lying, shoulder at 90°, gently press forearm down to mild stretch — for IR / posterior capsule. 20-30 sec/side, never to pain.

items.name: 1. Self-select
items.detail: Choose the routine for whatever feels most restricted that day — ankle, hip, or shoulder. Aim for 6-10 min.

mobility.group: Times/holds are starting guidelines from the articles — scale to feel, never push into pain. Friday 'Hip' runs the same routine as Tuesday 'Hips'; Monday & Thursday both run the Ankle routine.

track.a: BUCKNELL MEN'S LACROSSE — TRACK / FIELD CONDITIONING / AGILITY PROGRAM
Source: team summer program PDF (originally dated 2019; dates remapped to 2026 in the calendar).

track.b: Cones at 5, 10 & 15 yds from start. Run to cone 1 and back; cone 2 and back; cone 3 and finish through start.
Cones at start and 25 yds. Run to the 25-yd cone and back; repeat 6 total times = one set.
Cones at start and 53 yds (width of football field). Run to the 53-yd cone and finish through the start = one 1/2 gasser.
Cones at start and 50 yds. Sprint through the 50, rest 20 sec, sprint back through start, rest 20 sec, repeat for reps. (e.g. 3 sets of 6, rest 90 sec b/w sets).
Cones at start and 100 yds. Sprint through, rest 40 sec, sprint back, rest 40 sec, repeat for reps. (e.g. 3 sets of 6, rest 2 min b/w sets).
All cones 10 yds apart (soda cans / bottles work). Restart between each drill and give 100% effort. ('Three/Four/Five/Six' = number of cones in the drill set.)
Run the timed distance to track speed-endurance. After the timed run: 15-20 min light jog, then static stretching. Log your actual time.

5. Both feet side-to-side — 25x

7. L foot / R foot, swing non-jumping foot through — 25x each
8. High-knee run — 50x
9. Double jumps — 10x
